crossRefs.note: “ ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:
“ ‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every…
This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything…
This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,
This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;
and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
“Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley…
The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t…
For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for…
Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone…
